playback_policy: Tool-mediated read/write/re-read at checkpoints. No background automatic saves.
start_policy: No existing character may be loaded automatically. Start with blank identity, talent, sect/wanderer, point buy, heart art and 10-slot skill choice, then explicitly commit a NEW session.
deprecated_data_usage: DELETED_FROM_MAIN. Do not fetch old commit contents to restore previous characters absent fresh user consent.
history_note: Git historical commits are not removed by file deletion; repo history rewriting is out of scope.
